items.t: ci: skip the macOS and Windows unit test jobs when the plan selects nothing
ripple: count writes to pure globals as load-time effects
pfs: make the realcase test assert on Windows
ci: add a single PR Gate job for the Code OSS workflow
agentHost: resolve relative links and show URL approval targets
request: preserve response body timeout errors
chat: preserve dynamic provider labels in session hovers
ci: remove the required-checks job now that PR Gate is the required check
ripple: drop the 50% limit and always run only the affected unit tests
sessions: Delete user-shared environments from Remotes
ci: skip macOS and Windows Browser unit jobs without browser tests, and report a failed ripple plan
ci: run the chat-lib tests in one matrix job
sessions: add appearance tools and chat background skill
github: don't release response body readers in WebKit (deadlock)
ci: run only the integration tests a change can affect on macOS and Windows
ripple: add the overview video to the README
ripple: depend on the content of files that root paths name, and add `ripple why`
sessions: Surface remote connection errors and fix Remotes layout
Agent Host: hand in-flight HydraFusion workflow to the steering turn
Scope Agents window artifact and reference pills to the focused chat
sessions: Enable and gate Remote Environments management
sessions: dock the Session Activity Bar in a column of its own beside the chat
Agents - default the multi diff editor to cards in the Agents window
ci: fix the names of skipped PR checks
sessions: Show each artifact once, only in the chat that recorded it
chat: show response models for server-initiated turns
sessions: group artifact pills that share an integration into a dropdown
agentHost: re-enable MCP servers the host disabled when their decision is cleared

Canvases: Show canvas extensions in plugin results

intro.say: Thirty-six changes in a single day. Here are ten you'll notice.

changes.author: benibenj
changes.title: sessions: add appearance tools and chat background skill
changes.headline: The agent can now design your chat background
changes.say: A built-in skill now generates your chat background.

changes.author: chrmarti
changes.title: sessions: Delete user-shared environments from Remotes
changes.headline: Shared environments get a Delete action
changes.say: Shared environments now offer Delete, and it asks you first.

remove.title: Are you sure you want to delete environment 'my-devbox'?
remove.detail: This removes the environment registration and disconnects this client. Files on the machine will not be deleted. The environment may reappear if its owning application registers it again.

changes.author: chrmarti
changes.title: sessions: Enable and gate Remote Environments management
changes.headline: Remote Environments management, on by default
changes.say: Manage Remote Environments is now on by default, in the Sessions menu.

changes.author: alexdima
changes.title: Agents - default the multi diff editor to cards in the Agents window
changes.headline: In the Agents window, diffs default to cards
changes.say: In the Agents window, the multi diff editor now defaults to cards.

params.description: Controls the experimental variant of the multi diff editor.

changes.author: vritant24
changes.title: chat: allow cancelling a pending connector connection from its detail page
changes.headline: Cancel a connector while it connects
changes.say: While a connector connects, its page now offers Cancel.

params.name: Azure Data Explorer
params.description: Run Kusto queries and explore data in Azure Data Explorer.

changes.author: osortega
changes.title: chat: fix Cloud model picker pricing and context selection
changes.headline: Cloud models show their real context sizes
changes.say: In Cloud chats, a model's Details now show its real context sizes.

context.prompt: Summarize the release notes in the docs folder.

changes.author: justschen
changes.title: chat: fix Keep and Undo review synchronization
changes.headline: Reviews of agent edits stay in sync
changes.say: Reviews of agent edits now stay in sync with Keep and Undo.

params.title: Reviews of agent edits stay in sync

lines.text: Open diffs follow the agent's later edits.
Keep and Undo take effect before the next file opens.
Restoring a checkpoint keeps your unsaved edits.

changes.author: benibenj
changes.title: sessions: group artifact pills that share an integration into a dropdown
changes.headline: Pull requests in a chat share one pill
changes.say: Pull requests now share one pill; its dropdown lists each one.

context.prompt: Open a pull request for each fix.
context.reply: I opened five pull requests, one per fix.

changes.author: osortega
changes.title: agentHost: resolve relative links and show URL approval targets
changes.headline: Relative links open from the chat's folder
changes.say: Relative links in agent replies now open from the chat's working directory.

params.title: Relative links open from the chat's folder

lines.text: Relative file links open against the chat's working directory, in history too.
URL approvals show the URL before you approve.

changes.author: sbatten
changes.title: Agent Host: hand in-flight HydraFusion workflow to the steering turn
changes.headline: Steering HydraFusion no longer looks stuck
changes.say: And steering a running HydraFusion phase no longer looks stuck.

params.title: Steering HydraFusion no longer looks stuck

lines.text: A steering message takes over the running workflow.
The running phase shows again, and its tool calls keep appearing.
